look: Brand night map: warm charcoal ground, copper and gold lines, cream type, the Bombay Cafe Map cup logo, a spinning real-geography Mumbai map with rising 3D buildings, ticket card, stamps and word-by-word captions in the style of the user's reference reel

scenes.name: The hook
scenes.desc: The shape of Mumbai, a glowing highlight on Fort, then a zoom into Ballard Estate where the real buildings rise.

scenes.name: 1923 to now
scenes.desc: A timeline draws across the map: founded, handed down, still open.

scenes.name: The dish
scenes.desc: The berry pulao: three ingredient lines draw in and a dotted route runs from Iran to the pin.

scenes.name: The verdict
scenes.desc: A stamp lands, the rating meter fills to 4.2 and the line reads worth the trip, yes definitely.

scenes.name: Visit card
scenes.desc: A swaying ticket with the cafe logo and four icon rows: address, lunch only, closed Sundays, bring cash.

scenes.name: Next stop
scenes.desc: A glowing walker runs the dotted path and a pin drops onto Bombay Coffee House.

scenes.name: Your turn
scenes.desc: The map spins back out to the shape of Mumbai while the Bombay Cafe Map logo pops in with a poll card.
